messages:
ana (finance): Heads-up: Harbor Tech still shows INV-2026-342 ($42,600) overdue. AP told us they'd push a wire last week but we have no remittance yet. Can AE confirm status? We need a clear ETA before Friday to avoid suspension.

mike (acct-exec): I reached out to J. Lee earlier — they said they were waiting on PO HT-9987 to match the payment. I just resent the PO and asked for a remittance screenshot.

jlee (Harbor Tech): Apologies for delay — our procurement had a sign-off lag. We now have approval and the bank scheduled the wire for 2026-03-11 AM. We'll include INV-2026-342 and PO HT-9987 in the ref. I can push a partial payment if that helps.

ana (finance): Partial is acceptable as temporary relief. To avoid the billing hold we need at least 50% ($21,300) posted by 2026-03-12 09:00 UTC, with same-day proof (screenshot or remittance file). Please mask full account numbers in screenshots. Include invoice number in remittance reference.

mike (acct-exec): Also offered a one-time courtesy credit of $1,200 if they send full wire by EOD 2026-03-11. Harbor asked for that in writing. @jlee can you confirm you accept the credit and the 3/11 timeline?

jlee (Harbor Tech): Confirmed. We accept the $1,200 credit and will aim for the full wire on morning of 3/11. I'll post the bank confirmation here once it's available.

katie (legal): Note: escalation policy is a demand letter if the promised payment date is missed and funds do not clear within 7 calendar days. If wire misses 3/11, expect a demand letter around 3/18. Also check SOW for late-fee applicability before issuing any notice.

sara (support): FYI ops flagged a couple scheduled jobs that will be paused if account enters billing-hold. I can prepare a re-enable runbook to execute once payment clears; will need payment reference to match.

collections-bot: Reminder: Billing hold scheduled for account "harbor-tech" on 2026-03-12 09:00 UTC if balance > $0. Run `/payments check INV-2026-342` to refresh status.

ana (finance): Thanks. @mike when you get the remittance screenshot paste it here (mask acct numbers). I'll clear the pending hold and send the $1,200 credit confirmation email to J. Lee and cc this thread.

mike (acct-exec): Sent wire instructions to AP earlier. Quick copy: ```
Account: ****-1234
Ref: INV-2026-342 / HT-9987
Amount: $42,600
```

jlee (Harbor Tech): Bank confirms wire scheduled 03/11 09:30 PST. Will upload remittance in this thread after bank message. Appreciate the flexibility.

ana (finance): Great. Leaving open until remittance posted. If we don't see funds by 3/11 EOD we'll follow escalation steps. :v:
